question: Can a nondynamical spatial tensor sourced by the aether-acceleration Hessian preserve v10A's trace/shear geometry while making the complete frozen static principal block positive in the deep-MOND regime?
candidate: one-metric AeST plus an auxiliary symmetric aether-spatial polarization sourced by D_(m J_n)
action: S=S_AeST+(16 pi G)^-1 int sqrt(-g)[-(1/2) D_l P_mn D^l P^mn-L_P^-2(P:P/2+(P:P)^2/4)+beta P^mn D_(m J_n)+zeta^n A^m P_mn]

definitions.carrier: P_mn=P_nm and A^m P_mn=0; six auxiliary spatial components
definitions.time_kinetic_term: none; P is an elliptic spatial constraint and has no independent initial data
definitions.physical_metric: g_mn; matter and photons are minimally coupled to the same metric

fixed_coefficient_prescription.reason: the worst static Schur complement is exactly K_B/3 and the asymptotic longitudinal response is exactly 3

selection_gates.static_principal_energy: positive in longitudinal, transverse, and unmixed channels
selection_gates.auxiliary_dynamics: no independent P frequency root and positive subluminal reduced aether-vector speed
selection_gates.uniqueness: strictly convex carrier potential and bounded divergence operator
selection_gates.geometry: nonzero isotropic trace and spherical/STF tidal response
selection_gates.capacity: asymptotic longitudinal response closes at least 75% of the unit-to-3.14465 spent amplitude gap
selection_gates.linear_metric: static source changes Psi while the unchanged traceless equation retains Phi=Psi and delta Weyl=delta Psi
selection_gates.TT: D_(m J_n)=0 for a pure flat TT perturbation
selection_gates.complexity: at most five universal constants and no labels or object-specific field profile

mandatory_next_gates.ADM: perform full nonlinear lapse, shift, aether, scalar, P primary/secondary constraint count
mandatory_next_gates.principal_symbol: derive the complete scalar-vector-metric reduced characteristic determinant
mandatory_next_gates.metric_variation: derive nonlinear Psi, Phi, stress-energy, conservation, and Weyl equations from the action
mandatory_next_gates.causality: show the elliptic P constraint is preserved by causal evolution and does not transmit a physical instantaneous signal
mandatory_next_gates.local_cosmology: derive PPN, Solar screening, compact-source behavior, FLRW background, and perturbation stability

failure_rules.retire: retire exact v10B before data for an extra propagating mode, negative reduced kinetic/gradient direction, c_T change, nonunique homogeneous P state, physical instantaneous signal, or loss of one-metric lensing
failure_rules.no_patch: do not add a sixth constant, object label, lens-only term, or data-selected acceleration gate

prior_art_scope.project_specific_hypothesis: the fixed beta^2=2 K_B/3 auxiliary symmetric tensor sourced by D_(m J_n) as a one-metric baryon-geometry response

data_policy.authorization_after_selection: theory variation and numerical PDE construction only; no astronomical fitting
